description.en: The 3.5 mm three-conductor (tip, ring, sleeve) audio jack class: a Ø3.6 mm bore that takes a 3.5 mm TRS plug. A device's headphone or audio port is cut from it.
description.es: La clase de jack de audio de 3.5 mm de tres conductores (punta, anillo, manga): un barreno de Ø3.6 mm que recibe un plug TRS de 3.5 mm. El puerto de audífonos o de audio de un aparato se recorta a partir de ella.
description.fr: La classe de jack audio 3,5 mm à trois conducteurs (pointe, bague, manchon) : un alésage de Ø3,6 mm qui reçoit une fiche TRS 3,5 mm. Le port casque ou audio d'un appareil se découpe d'après elle.
description.pt: A classe de jack de áudio de 3,5 mm de três condutores (ponta, anel, manga): um furo de Ø3,6 mm que recebe um plugue TRS de 3,5 mm. A porta de fones ou de áudio de um aparelho recorta-se a partir dela.

sources.title: Same Sky SJ1-352XN 3.5 mm PCB audio jack (rev 1.06) datasheet
sources.supports: mating plug Ø3.5, 14 from the shoulder to the tip; bore Ø3.60 +0.1/−0.05; pins 1 sleeve, 2 tip, 3 ring

sources.title: Same Sky SJ1-353X 3.5 mm threaded audio jack (rev 1.04) datasheet
sources.supports: bore Ø3.60; M6 × 0.5 bushing 4.0 long with an Ø8.0 × 1.80 nut; pins 1 sleeve, 2 tip, 3 ring

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the bore on the jack's front face. +z points out of the bore, toward a plug; the body lies at z < 0. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the bore is round, so the interface has continuous symmetry.

bore_diameter.note: the threaded SJ1-353X draws the same Ø3.60 (source 1)

plug_diameter.note: the mating plug the sheet names

plug_length.note: the mating plug, shoulder to tip

conductors.note: sleeve, tip, ring; SJ1-353X the same (source 1)

interfaces.note: Female: a 3.5 mm plug enters the bore. A mate seats the plug's shoulder on the jack's front face, a convention: no source states the seated position.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: IEC 60603-11, which governs the connector, is not freely published, so this is a class entry stated by the facts two jack series of one maker share (the bore and the mating plug). A panel-mount member's bushing (M6 × 0.5 on SJ1-353X) and every body outline vary by part and are not stated.
